session.title: Resolving testing bottlenecks and urgent task generation targets
session.summary:
## BLUF
The team debated testing pipeline bottlenecks but agreed the immediate priority is accelerating high-quality task generation to meet an urgent weekend deadline.

## Decisions
- Prioritize generating task volume over immediate tooling improvements.
- Target a quota of 25 completed tasks per day to reach 100 tasks within four days.
- Utilize the VS Code extension and benign tasks to navigate environment testing more safely.

## Key Outcomes
- Identified slow (30-minute) Taiga feedback loops as a major driver of context switching and frustration.
- Realigned team focus on the urgent backlog: Ryan routing to 'ready for auto' and Spencer driving final QA.

## Risks/Notes
- The 30-minute QA feedback loop severely hampers engineering focus and causes mistakes to slip through.
- Lack of a straightforward task-to-environment mapping adds unnecessary cognitive load.
- Failing to maintain the 25-task daily pace will jeopardize weekend deliverables.
